facts.statement: The only known specimen of Zholsuchus was found in the Turonian-age Upper Cretaceous Bissekty Formation of Dzharakhuduk, Uzbekistan.
facts.quote: This specimen was found in the Turonian-age Upper Cretaceous Bissekty Formation of Dzharakhuduk, Uzbekistan

facts.statement: Zholsuchus was described in 1989 by Lev Nessov and colleagues.
facts.quote: Zholsuchus was described in 1989 by Lev Nessov and colleagues

facts.statement: The type species of Zholsuchus is Z. procevus.
facts.quote: The type species is Z. procevus

facts.statement: A 2000 review by Glenn Storrs and Mikhail Efimov designated Zholsuchus as a dubious name.
facts.quote: A 2000 review by Glenn Storrs and Mikhail Efimov designated Zholsuchus a dubious name

facts.statement: Zholsuchus is known only from scanty material, specifically a right premaxilla, which is one of the bones at the tip of the snout.
facts.quote: es conocido solo a partir de material muy escaso (un premaxilar derecho, uno de los huesos de la punta del hocico)

facts.statement: Zholsuchus lived between 100.5 and 72.2 million years ago, during the Cenomanian to Campanian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Campanian (100.5 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Zholsuchus belongs to the parent group Crocodylia.

rejected.statement: Zholsuchus is a genus of crocodyliform that may have been a goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian.
rejected.quote: Zholsuchus is a genus of crocodyliform that may have been a goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian
